idea_text: A lightweight project management tool for small teams (5-20 people). Features: task boards (Kanban), time tracking, file attachments, team chat. Must work offline-first with sync. Competitors: Trello (too simple), Jira (too complex). Our angle: simplicity + offline.
target_audience: Small software teams (5-20 devs) who need lightweight project management without enterprise overhead. Currently using spreadsheets or basic tools.

idea_text: Mobile app for tracking daily health habits: water intake, sleep, exercise, medication. Gamification with streaks and achievements. Integration with Apple Health and Google Fit. Subscription model: free tier (3 habits), premium ($4.99/mo, unlimited + analytics).
target_audience: Health-conscious adults aged 25-45 who want to build better habits but find existing apps too complicated or too gamified.
